QEVA SOURCE POLICY 0.1

1. A source record states where information came from; it does not certify mathematical truth.
2. Prefer official APIs, dumps, feeds, and bulk exports to ad-hoc page scraping.
3. Respect robots directives, rate limits, access controls, contracts/terms, copyright, and database rights.
4. Do not bypass anti-bot or access-control mechanisms.
5. Metadata, abstracts, reviews, figures, source files, and PDFs may have different rights. Track rights at the field/item level.
6. Mirror full text only when permitted. Otherwise preserve identifiers, metadata, derived factual structure where lawful, and canonical links.
7. Imported records retain their source licenses. QEVA's CC0 license applies only to QEVA-created material.
8. Machine extraction produces candidates. Mathematical status must be separately qualified as definition, theorem, proof, conjecture, refutation, empirical claim, interpretation, or unknown.
9. Preserve corrections and retractions; never silently erase a historical state.
10. Logical dependency and historical/citation dependency are distinct edge types.
